title: FollowBench: A Multi-level Fine-grained Constraints Following Benchmark for Large Language Models
reasoning: The 'Ethics Statement' section on page 9 outlines the paper's commitment to 'ensuring safe and responsible practices' and details a 'meticulous human review process to identify and eliminate any potentially harmful instructions or offensive content' from the FollowBench data. This shows that the benchmark's data quality control inherently includes an ethical component to prevent harmful outputs from LLMs, which is part of evaluating their ethical instruction following.
